text: Why Neural-Network Training Can Benefit from Memetics Pure gradient training may struggle when: @ the loss surface is highly nonconvex @ initialization matters too much @ there are several qualitatively different policy families Pure evolutionary training may struggle when: @ gradients are available but ignored @ high precision is needed near a good solution @ many evaluations are wasted on near-correct candidates Memetic search helps because it separates the tasks: @ evolution proposes useful regions in weight space @ local search performs precise tuning in those regions This is especially attractive in control-style neural optimization. -
